title: learn-micro-gpt concept frontmatter
description: The YAML frontmatter of every file in content/concepts/. Validated by tools/validate_concepts.py. The parser is tools/yamlite.py, a strict subset -- see that module for exactly which YAML features are allowed.

id.description: Slug. Must equal the filename stem. Globally unique.

chapter.description: Chapter id; must exist in content/index.json.

order.description: Position within the chapter, 1-based. Unique per chapter; must match the position in content/index.json's chapter concept list.

summary.description: One or two sentences. This is the graph node label and the meta description, so it has to work out of context.

difficulty.description: 1 = skimmable, 2 = the main event, 3 = will make you think. Optional; defaults to 2.

math.description: Optional KaTeX/LaTeX. Rendered in a display block. No delimiters -- the app supplies them.

shapes.description: Optional tensor shapes at this hyperparameter setting, so a reader can see that [T, 4] really is 4 columns and not an abstraction.

anchors.description: Where this concept lives in each language, as AST selectors -- never line numbers. Required: python. Optional per language, and CI fails if a key names a language that has no source file.

related.description: Concept ids shown as 'see also'. Not prerequisites -- a reader may go here in any order.

prereqs.description: Concept ids that should be read first. Drives the chapter nav and the graph edges. CI rejects cycles.

traces.description: Optional recorded-run widgets to inline in the body. Each entry is a :::trace directive argument set; see docs/TRACE-FORMAT.md.

selector.description: Selector grammar: def:<name>, assign:<name>, comment:<exact prefix>, section:<exact prefix> (that comment through to the next section boundary), plus an optional offset:[dStart, dEnd] of deltas applied after resolution.

offset.description: Deltas relative to the resolved span. Optional here; may also be written inline in the selector as `offset:[a, b]`.
